questions.text: I can accurately identify my emotions as they occur throughout the day.
I understand the specific triggers that cause me to feel irritated, anxious, or joyful.
I often find myself reacting strongly without realizing what emotion is driving my behavior.
I have an honest understanding of both my personal strengths and emotional blind spots.
I notice physical sensations (e.g. muscle tension, heart rate) that signal emerging feelings.
When provoked, I can pause and choose a deliberate response rather than reacting impulsively.
I adapt smoothly when circumstances require altering established routines or plans.
I struggle to calm myself down once I become angry or emotionally distressed.
I can sustain composure and clear thinking under demanding deadline pressure.
I take responsibility for my emotional reactions instead of projecting blame onto others.
I stay dedicated to meaningful goals even when immediate external rewards are absent.
I view failures and mistakes as constructive opportunities for learning and mastery.
I easily lose drive and abandon initiatives when encountering initial resistance.
I proactively take initiative to improve situations without waiting to be prompted.
I maintain an optimistic, solutions-oriented focus when tackling complex problems.
I easily sense what another person is feeling from their tone of voice and body language.
I listen attentively to understand others' perspectives, even when I disagree with them.
I often find it difficult to appreciate why people react emotionally to certain situations.
I anticipate how my words or actions might impact the emotional state of people around me.
I show genuine sensitivity when someone shares a personal struggle with me.
I navigate interpersonal disagreements productively by seeking collaborative solutions.
I communicate clearly and build rapport effectively with diverse individuals.
I feel awkward or ineffective when attempting to lead or influence group discussions.
I actively foster teamwork, cooperation, and positive group morale.
I can deliver constructive feedback in a supportive, respectful manner.
